notes: New Loans tab: add each loan (balance, yearly rate, minimum payment) and see its payoff date and total interest — plus a payoff plan where extra money each month goes to your highest-rate loan first, showing the new payoff date and exactly how much interest you save vs minimums only. A 'use half/all my leftover' button fills the extra from your Budget tab's monthly leftover, so 'what can I put in' comes from your real budget.
Also includes the v2.21.0 paycheck fixes: flat per-check fees no longer multiply on every-2-weeks/monthly pay, and the monthly next-payday countdown no longer skips payday-today.
